recognize_zh: 周邊血液中有數顆中型淋巴球，核圓形、染色質均勻，細胞質淡灰藍且邊緣長出一圈細毛狀突起（hairy projections），是毛細胞白血病的典型樣子。
features: Three medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than a small lymphocyte
Moderate to abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
Round to oval nuclei with evenly dispersed, homogeneous chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
One cell at right lacks projections and has clumped chromatin (likely a normal lymphocyte); red cells with rouleaux-like stacking in thick area
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several atypical medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale blue-grey cytoplasm bearing fine circumferential hair-like projections. A separate small lymphocyte lacks these projections. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus and are CD25/CD123 negative, whereas these cells lack visible nucleoli.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar (bipolar) villi and more condensed chromatin rather than circumferential fine projections.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, so immunophenotype (CD25-, CD103 often -, annexin A1-) and BRAF wild type separate it from HCL.
